item.title: Isekai no Shugo-Hime wa, Norowareshi Akki no Kiss o Matsu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: LiLinn
  • 発売日: 2013-12-16
  • スコア: 5.8100000000000005/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 異世界の守護姫は、呪われし悪鬼のキスを待つ
  • 英語名: Isekai no Shugo-Hime wa, Norowareshi Akki no Kiss o Matsu

别名

  • Other world guardian

あらすじ

One night, a student Ryo, tries out a astral projection and is sucked

into a world named MUGEN KAIROU (the corridor of dreams an fantasy).

Floating in the air, in an unknown world, he finally realizes his floating

in mid air is an impossibility and subsequently begins to fall.

item.title: Mugen Yuuki ~Me no Mae de, Haibokushi Ryakudatsu Sare Ochiru Shoujo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: LiLinn
  • 発売日: 2013-01-31
  • スコア: 5.6/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢幻優姫～目の前で、敗北し略奪され堕ちる少女～
  • 英語名: Mugen Yuuki Me no Mae de, Haibokushi Ryakudatsu Sare Ochiru Shoujo

あらすじ

The protagonist, Yuuichi, found a strange girl in a rainy alleyway. A beautiful girl, dressed in pink and frills. A girl who reached out and grabbed his hand, ever so gently. She held onto him, her hands shockingly cold.

Then, she told him–

“I finally found you…the source of my power…”
